transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... most days I just feel like I’m sitting at the bottom of a dark hole. It's hard to explain, but even when I’m around people I know, I just can’t seem to shake this really heavy, hopeless feeling. It's just always there.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change?

Yeah, it did. Um, this has been going on for about a year and two months now. It all started right after a fall I had at my HVAC job. It left me with a back injury, and... well, everything just kind of started unraveling after that.
Before your injury, had you already been feeling down or hopeless most days for at least two years?

No, not at all. Um, before the fall, I was doing fine. I mean, I was just working and going about my normal life. I definitely wasn't feeling down or hopeless like this back then. It really just started after I got hurt.
Do these heavy, hopeless feelings mostly happen when you think about your back injury and how it changed things?

No, um... not really. I mean, it's not just when I think about my back or the fall. It's more like... it's just there all the time now, no matter what I'm thinking about. Even if my mind is completely on something else, or I'm just sitting at home, that heavy feeling doesn't go away. It's just constant.
Before this started after your fall, had you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?

No, um, never. I've never felt anything like this before the accident. I mean, I've had bad days here and there, like anyone, but never this heavy, dark feeling that just sticks around for weeks. This is all completely new to me since I got hurt.
Have these feelings made it hard for you to work or handle your usual daily responsibilities?

Yes. It's... it's made everything really hard. I haven't been able to keep up with my field work at all, or even just the business side of things. I'm an installation and repair worker, and I'm just... I'm missing calls, missing deadlines. Even regular bills at home that I used to handle without a second thought, I just can't seem to get them done. I've also been pulling away from my friends and the makerspace I used to go to. Honestly, most days I'm just sitting at home, trying to get through the day.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yes, completely. I used to really enjoy hiking, painting... even going to the makerspace to tinker with things. I also used to get a lot of satisfaction out of figuring out a tricky install for work. But now... I just don't care. I'll look at my painting supplies or my tools, and I just stare at them. I ignore calls from my friends or clients because... it just doesn't feel worth the effort to even start. None of it brings me any joy anymore.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yes, I have. I've been having thoughts that... well, that everyone would just be better off if I didn't wake up. And sometimes, when the physical pain and all the money worries really pile up on me, I actually catch myself thinking about ending it. It scares me that my mind goes there, but... yes, I've had those thoughts.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, I have. It's... it's really been a struggle. I either lie awake for hours in the dark, with my back hurting and all those bills running through my head, or... I end up sleeping for half the day. But even when I do sleep that much, I still wake up feeling like I never rested at all.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite?

Yeah, my eating is really all over the place. I'll usually go most of the day just running on coffee, because honestly, the thought of food just turns my stomach right now. But then late at night, I'll end up just picking at whatever's in the cabinet... I don't even really taste it, I'm just eating whatever is there.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge a lot of the time?

No, not really. I mean, I worry about things like my back and the bills, like I said, but I wouldn't say I feel anxious or on edge all the time. It's more just this heavy, tired feeling than being keyed up.
